modelMetadata.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
modelMetadata.descriptionZh: Google 面向软件工程、长任务 Agent 和知识工作推出的 Flash 系列多模态模型；本站评测验证编程创作作品。
modelMetadata.descriptionEn: Google Flash model for software engineering, agents and knowledge work, accepting multimodal input and returning text.

summaryZh: 本批11项均已交付并接受检查，SVG和书架的主要几何与布局要求完成得较好；机械实体、室内动线和细节执行仍有明显问题。四部知识片均达到1080p、60–90秒，但字幕时序、二维码纠错例及来源外推影响了可靠性。作品保留可编辑文件和源码，使用前仍需核对几何、字幕与事实。
summaryEn: All 11 tasks were delivered and inspected. SVGs and the bookshelf meet their main geometric and layout requirements reasonably well; the mechanical solids, interior circulation and detailing have substantial defects. All four knowledge films reach 1080p and 60–90 seconds, but caption timing, the QR correction example and unsupported source extrapolations affect reliability. Editable projects and source are preserved; geometry, captions and facts still need checking before use.
methodZh: creative-suite-v4：三项 Blender、四项日期锁定知识视频、三项静态 SVG 与一项 SMIL 动画。模型通过 Google Developer API 兼容工具循环独立编写源码，本地渲染生成画面；协调者只编排、检查和整理交付。未强制 thinkingLevel，文档默认 MEDIUM；未独立测定每次请求的实际思考档位。 知识片旁白统一由本地 Kokoro zf_xiaobei（lang z）合成，未评测 Gemini 原生语音生成。Blender 影片使用程序配乐与音效，无旁白。
methodEn: creative-suite-v4: three Blender tasks, four date-locked knowledge videos, three static SVGs and one SMIL animation. The model independently authors source through the Google Developer API-compatible tool loop; local renderers generate media. The coordinator orchestrates, inspects and packages. No thinkingLevel was forced; the documented default is MEDIUM, without per-request independent measurement. Knowledge narration uses the fixed local Kokoro zf_xiaobei voice (lang z); Gemini-native speech generation was not evaluated. Blender films use procedural music and effects, without narration.
workflowNoteZh: 画面点评由 AI 完成；尺寸、媒体和音频检查使用程序。不冒称人工评分或实际听审。accepted 表示交付和检查完成，质量问题保留在各题简评。
workflowNoteEn: Visual observations are by AI; dimensions, media and audio checks use scripts. No human scoring or actual listening is claimed. Accepted means delivery and inspection; quality defects remain in the case notes.
usageNoteZh: 原生 P/C/T、cache 和明确返回的 reasoning 逐请求保留在公开账目。C 不保证包含全部隐藏思考，缺失不是 0，不用 T−P−C 推算。完整输入/输出总量未知，展示为 —；已知小计不是完整账单。
usageNoteEn: Native P/C/T, cache and explicitly returned reasoning are retained per request in the public ledger. C is not guaranteed to include all hidden thinking; missing is not zero and T−P−C is not inferred as reasoning. Complete input/output totals are unknown and shown as —; known subtotals are not a full bill.
billingZh: API 未返回实际账单或抵扣金额，实际费用未知；未用价格估算替代账单。
billingEn: The API did not return actual charges or credit deductions. Actual monetary cost is unknown; no price estimate substitutes for billing.
limitationsZh: 不公开完整题目输入、私有续接、事件日志或隐藏思考。
源码 ZIP 是审阅文件的公开派生包：TTS 元数据脱敏及可选截图助手排除逐项列明；作品、音轨与其余作者文件字节保留。
原生工程保留作者内嵌脚本。没有完整从零复建认证，也没有人工听审认证。
模型 ID 是提供商返回的精确别名；未公布可验证的不可变 checkpoint。
limitationsEn: Full task inputs, private continuations, event logs and hidden thinking are excluded.
Source ZIPs are reviewed public derivatives: TTS metadata sanitization and optional helper exclusions are listed. Artwork, audio and other author member bytes are retained.
Native projects retain author-embedded scripts. Complete from-zero reproducibility and human listening are not certified.
Model identity is the exact returned provider alias, without a published verifiable immutable checkpoint.

cases.titleZh: 参数化书架及参数修改
cases.summaryZh: 两版书架的宽度与三格／四格变化直观，六张图机位和材质一致。部分“孔”为凸起圆柱，背板约1mm交叠，第二版还改了额外细节。
cases.summaryEn: The wider four-compartment shelf is easy to compare with the three-compartment version in six consistent views. Some holes are raised cylinders, the backboard overlaps by about 1 mm, and the second version changes additional details.

assessmentZh: 两版均有完整入画的主视角、背面与清楚的结构近景，浅木纹、倒角和托销可辨；宽度与三格/四格变化直观，六张图机位和材质一致，便于比较。孔位实际是凸起圆柱装饰，近景更像圆片，不能当作已钻孔。背板与横板约1mm范围交叠；V2还改了硬件倒角和装饰孔位，因此不能宣称保存的两工程严格只有宽度和格数变化。
assessmentEn: Both versions provide a fully framed main view, rear view and clear joint close-up. Light wood grain, bevels and shelf supports are visible; the wider four-compartment version is easy to compare with the three-compartment version. The apparent holes are raised cylindrical details rather than drilled voids. The back panel overlaps the shelf bounds by about 1 mm, and V2 also changes hardware bevels and decorative-hole offsets, so the saved projects are not strictly a two-parameter-only change.

assessmentEn: The 84.5-second film explains ANC without music using six graphic layouts, moving waveforms/meters and 21 captions, with idealization and residual-sound notes. Full decode and segment timing checks pass. Dense text and dB/energy/health assertions beyond the frozen Bose source are the main limitations. Loudness is below its stated plan; actual listening and pronunciation remain unverified.

assessmentEn: The orange bill and throat pouch, white pelican and teal bicycle are recognizable, with clear wheels, frame, saddle, handlebar and basket. Spokes, crank and both legs visibly move; feet remain on the pedals and hips remain attached to the body. Moving clouds and road add travel, while the rider and bicycle remain on canvas. The 0/4-second boundary differs only by negligible pixels and the loop looks continuous. The near leg appears long and its knee bend is stiff in some phases.
